test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The National eCourts Project, launched by the Department of Justice, is primarily aimed at:

options.text: building new court complexes in rural areas
establishing a nationwide telecom system for police
digitising and upgrading district and subordinate courts

solution:
The correct answer is __**digitising and upgrading district and subordinate courts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National eCourts Project**: This initiative was launched by the **Department of Justice** under the aegis of the **Government of India** to digitise judicial processes and improve efficiency in the functioning of **district and subordinate courts**.
 
• It primarily aims to integrate technology into the judicial system by creating a **digital infrastructure** for courts, enabling them to function efficiently and transparently.
 
• **Digitisation and Upgradation:** The project focuses on **computerisation** of courts, e-filing, e-payment, case information systems, and real-time updates, which ensures faster resolution of cases. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• **Accessibility:** By digitising court records, litigants and advocates can access case details and judgments easily, reducing dependency on manual processes and ensuring **transparency**.
 
• The project aligns with the broader vision of **Digital India**, which aims at transforming India into a digitally empowered society. *Hence, the correct answer is focused on digitisation and upgradation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Objectives of National eCourts Project:**

 
 
• **Enhancing Efficiency:** The project aims to reduce pendency of cases by implementing effective case management systems and **streamlining judicial processes**.
 
• **Ease of Access:** It provides litigants and lawyers access to case status, judgments, and other court-related information online, promoting **judicial transparency**.
 
• **Integration of Technology:** The initiative introduces **technological tools** such as video conferencing for trials and hearings, enabling remote access to justice.
 
 
 
• **Key Features:**
 
 
• **Case Information System:** A dedicated platform for tracking the status of cases and pending matters.
 
• **E-Filing and E-Payment:** Litigants can file cases and make payments online, reducing the need for physical presence in courts.
 
• **National Judicial Data Grid:** A repository of judicial data that provides insights into case pendency and disposal rates.
 
 
 
• **Digitisation Benefits:**
 
 
• **Reduced Paperwork:** The project minimises the use of physical records, thereby promoting **eco-friendly practices**.
 
• **Transparency:** Digitisation ensures accountability by providing litigants real-time access to case information.
 
• **Cost Reduction:** It reduces operational costs for courts, litigants, and advocates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Central Administrative Tribunals:** These tribunals are established for adjudicating disputes related to **service matters** of public servants. However, this is not the objective of the National eCourts Project.
 
• **Building New Court Complexes:** Constructing physical infrastructure in rural areas is important for accessibility, but this is not the primary aim of the project.
 
• **Nationwide Telecom System:** Establishing a telecom system for police functions is unrelated to the scope of the National eCourts Project, which focuses solely on **judicial digitisation**.
